purpose: pin the actual upstream GARM controller image/provider bundle before additive TrueNAS appliance packaging
known_upstream_seams: At the pinned v0.2.1 source commit, the Dockerfile build loop builds garm-provider-linode but the final image stage does not COPY it.
At the pinned v0.2.1 source commit, garm-provider-oci is not present in the Dockerfile build/final-image provider list even though newer/current GARM provider documentation lists OCI as supported.
The preservation contract is therefore based on the actual pinned image contents, not on a current documentation table or an intermediate build-loop list.
claim_boundary: This profile proves appliance-base byte preservation only; it does not functionally qualify any bundled provider or the controller on TrueNAS.
